phrase: among the last important books written primarily in latin prose were the works of swedenborg , linnaeus , euler , gauss , and isaac newton . sculpture in berlin depicting a stack of books on which are inscribed the names of great german writers see also: genre fiction and hypertext fiction a novel is a long fictional narrative, usually written in prose. in english, the term emerged from the romance languages in the late 15th century, with the meaning of "news"; it came to indicate something new, without a distinction between fact or fiction.
